events.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
events.description: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours. What it was trying to achieve is reconstructed afterwards and disputed.

events.title: AI Investment Collapse
events.description: Capital flees the sector. Valuations reset hard, announced build-out is cancelled rather than delayed, and several of the arrangements European compute was depending on evaporate with it. What the frontier laboratories can afford to train shrinks for the first time.

events.title: Labour Displacement Wave
events.description: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced. The numbers are argued about; the absence of hiring is not.

portfolio.name: Open Science Resilience Initiative
portfolio.description: Establish a pan-European network of public research institutes and open-weight developers focused on high-assurance, auditable AI systems for biosecurity, climate modelling, and critical infrastructure resilience, with guaranteed deployment pathways into EU agencies and member state operations` — in flight

portfolio.name: Secure foundational resilience through joint threat response integration
portfolio.description: Embed EU systems into the new joint cyber-biosurveillance pact with real-time telemetry sharing, binding incident response protocols, and co-located analysis cells

new_measure: Launch the Auditable AI Acceleration Programme
